definitions.explanation: A label used primarily on canned coffee and other beverages to indicate a small amount of added sugar, less than regular sweetened versions but not sugar-free.

examples.japanese: {微糖|びとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{微糖|びとう}にした。
examples.english: I don't like sweet things, so I went with low sugar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{微糖|びとう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{無糖|むとう}→無糖：19091_mutou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{缶|かん}→缶：01076_kan⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: The vending machine has low-sugar and sugar-free canned coffees lined up.

notes:
Extremely common on Japanese beverage labels, especially canned coffee. The sweetness levels for canned coffee in Japan typically follow this scale:

- ⟦{加糖|かとう}→加糖：20005_katou⟧: sweetened (standard sugar)
- {微糖|びとう}: slightly sweetened / low sugar
- ⟦{無糖|むとう}→無糖：19091_mutou⟧: unsweetened / sugar-free
- ⟦ブラック→ブラック：08787_burakku⟧: black (no sugar or milk)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {微糖|びとう}⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧: low-sugar coffee
- {微糖|びとう}⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧: low-sugar type

CULTURAL NOTE:
The exact sugar content for {微糖|びとう} is not legally defined in Japan, so it varies by manufacturer. It generally contains less sugar than ⟦{加糖|かとう}→加糖：20005_katou⟧ but is not zero.
